description:
The Petersen Automotive Museum in Los Angeles, California has successfully transitioned from a specialized local collection into a world-class authority, managing an archive of approximately 250 superlative vehicles. Through high-stakes rotating exhibitions—such as the 100-year history of Aston Martin—the museum explores the critical intersection of precision engineering and heritage record-keeping. By granting public access to historically significant vehicles that are rarely seen outside private vaults, the Petersen serves as a vital guardian of the global automotive legacy and a primary driver of Los Angeles car culture.

Beyond high-end luxury, the Petersen has featured rotating exhibits like the "Totally Awesome" era of the 1980s and '90s, where the dawn of the digital age fundamentally altered vehicle design.
